resume_assessment.source_output_coupling_blocker: Current training code uses one checkpoint manager path for both restore and output. A new versioned continuation output directory therefore requires a later approved code change adding a separate resume source, or an approved checkpoint copy. A HOME-to-WORK symlink is not an acceptable workaround.
